auth_method.description: How this request authenticated: session, api_key or oauth.
auth_method.title: Auth Method

email.description: The account's sign-in email, for labelling connections.
email.title: Email

callback_url.description: Public https URL to POST to once when the job finishes (completed, partial, failed or cancelled). Signed with callback_secret; carries ids and state only.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

format.description: Result format; one of the outcome's formats. Defaults to its default_format.
format.title: Format

gcs_uris.description: gs:// URIs returned by POST /api/v1/upload-urls. Send this or sources, not both.
gcs_uris.title: Gcs Uris

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated id for this submission. Retrying with the same key and request returns the same job; the same key with a different request is a 409.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

options.description: Outcome options; see the outcome's options_schema.
options.title: Options

sources.description: Files to fetch from public https URLs instead of uploading them. Send this or gcs_uris.
sources.title: Sources

ErrorDetail.description: Machine-readable error. Extra fields depend on ``code``.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

outcomes.description: Outcomes available to the caller's plan. A fixed, small list.
outcomes.title: Outcomes

callback_secret.description: Only with callback_url: verify each callback's ScribeTools-Signature header (t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.' + body>) with this secret.
callback_secret.title: Callback Secret

created.description: False when an earlier request with this idempotency key made the job.
created.title: Created

credits_reserved.description: Credits held for this job; charged only for work that completes.
credits_reserved.title: Credits Reserved

kind.description: 'file': stored as produced. 'export': rendered from the job's structured output on first download.
kind.title: Kind

size_bytes.description: Unknown for an export until its first download.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

source_filename.description: The input file this result came from.
source_filename.title: Source Filename

results.description: One per completed file, in submission order.
results.title: Results

credits_reserved.description: Credits still held for unfinished items.
credits_reserved.title: Credits Reserved

state.description: queued, processing, completed, partial, failed, or cancelled.
state.title: State

state.description: completed, partial, failed, or cancelled; every unfinished job is listed as processing. GET /api/v1/outcome-jobs/{id} distinguishes queued from processing.
state.title: State

accepted_mime_types.description: Input file types this outcome accepts.
accepted_mime_types.title: Accepted Mime Types

credits_per_page.description: Credits per input page with default options. Each file's total is rounded up; some options (EPUB embed_pdf_pages) raise it.
credits_per_page.title: Credits Per Page

default_format.description: Result format used when none is requested.
default_format.title: Default Format

formats.description: Result formats this outcome can produce.
formats.title: Formats

id.description: Pass this as `outcome` when creating a job.
id.title: Id

options_schema.description: JSON Schema of `options` for this outcome, exactly as enforced.
options_schema.title: Options Schema

data.description: The parsed result, for JSON results.
data.title: Data

text.description: The result's text, for TXT results.
text.title: Text

url.description: Short-lived signed URL. GET it without an Authorization header.
url.title: Url

filename.description: Name to give the file. Defaults to the server's filename or the URL's last path segment.
filename.title: Filename

url.description: Public https URL of a PDF or image. Fetched once, when the job is created.
url.title: Url

file_infos.description: Per-file upload metadata. Preferred over files/file_pages because it is stable when multiple files have the same filename.
file_infos.title: File Infos

file_pages.description: Map of filename to page count
file_pages.title: File Pages

file_sizes.description: Map of filename to file size in bytes
file_sizes.title: File Sizes

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated submission id. Reusing it returns stable upload paths and allows job creation to collapse request replays.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

get.description:
Who this credential belongs to, its plan and pages (plan 017).

Integrations use it to test a connection and label it.

post.description: Create a job by outcome name. The server builds the pipeline.

403.description: Not allowed for this caller or plan

get.description: Compact status. While not terminal, Retry-After says when to poll again.

post.description:
Cancel a running job. Completed steps' output stays and is charged;
unused holds are released. Cancelling a finished job changes nothing.

get.description: One result per completed file. Listing never renders or charges.

A TXT or JSON result's content, up to 1 MiB (plan 017).

For automation steps that map extracted text or fields directly. Other
formats and larger results are download-only.

A short-lived signed URL for one result.

DOCX/XLSX/CSV are rendered on the first download and reused after that;
on plans with a free-export allowance the first download of each such
result uses one export.

post.description: Generate signed URLs for direct GCS uploads. Session or API key.

403.description: Not allowed for this caller or plan
